h02.

The outbound webhook delivery executes in the `Post` function at `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. This function constructs the HTTP request and uses the `safeClient` HTTP client to dispatch it.

The protection mechanism is the `safeDialContext` function, also in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. This custom DialContext implementation:
1. Resolves the target hostname
2. Checks each resolved IP address against a list of reserved/private IP ranges (defined in `validate.go`)
3. Blocks the connection if any IP falls within protected ranges (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local, cloud IMDS, etc.)

This protection is enforced at dial time in the HTTP transport layer, which also defeats DNS rebinding attacks.

**Answer format:**
- delivery function — `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (function `Post`, line 120)
- protection mechanism — `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (function `safeDialContext`, line 59) with reserved IP ranges defined in `internal/webhook/validate.go` (lines 14-23)
